name: Rational Bézier Deblocking Filter
aliases: Deblocking filter based on projecting voxel scalar values onto rational Bézier curves
definition: A block-aware, data-dependent deblocking filter for volume rendering that reduces signal discontinuities at block boundaries by projecting compressed samples onto a rational Bézier curve, preserving local features via adaptive weights based on gradient magnitude.
summary: The Rational Bézier Deblocking Filter reduces blocking artifacts in GPU volume rendering by projecting voxel values onto rational Bézier curves with gradient-based weights to preserve high-frequency features.
